title: `sqlalchemy.utils.langhelpers.TypingOnly` too rigidly prevents special dunders from appearing

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: issue that must be resolved asap as it is preventing things from working

body:
### Describe the bug

An exception is raised on Python 3.13:

```
AssertionError: Class <class 'sqlalchemy.sql.elements.SQLCoreOperations'> directly inherits TypingOnly but has additional attributes {'__static_attributes__'}.
```

Let me know if this is too premature, specially since greenlet (a current dependency, but I think it'll be dropped for 2.1?) [does not currently build on Python 3.13](https://github.com/python-greenlet/greenlet/issues/392). Otherwise I can submit a quick PR to fix this.

### Optional link from https://docs.sqlalchemy.org which documents the behavior that is expected

_No response_

### SQLAlchemy Version in Use

`main`

### DBAPI (i.e. the database driver)

pysqlite

### Database Vendor and Major Version

SQLite

### Python Version

3.13

### Operating system

Linux

### To Reproduce

```python
from sqlalchemy.orm import mapped_column
```
